name: @nikolacehic/archetype
description: Frontend implementation contracts for AI coding agents.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate --input examples/saas-dashboard-intake.json --out tmp/archetype-output
scripts.demo:generate: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate --input examples/saas-dashboard-intake.json --out tmp/archetype-output
scripts.demo:verify: npm run validate && npm run simulate && npm run write-target && npm run verify-target
scripts.test: npm run cli:contract && npm run mcp:contract && npm run plugin:claude:contract && npm run plugin:codex:contract && npm run distribution:contract && npm run pivot:audit && npm run lifecycle:contract && npm run spec:contract && npm run test-first:contract && npm run install:contract && npm run golden
scripts.check: npm run cli:contract && npm run mcp:contract && npm run plugin:claude:contract && npm run plugin:codex:contract && npm run distribution:contract && npm run pivot:audit && npm run lifecycle:contract && npm run spec:contract && npm run test-first:contract && npm run install:contract && npm run golden
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist tmp/archetype-output tmp/generated-frontend tmp/golden tmp/cli-contract tmp/mcp-contract tmp/lifecycle-contract tmp/spec-contract tmp/test-first-contract tmp/install-contract tmp/demo
